game.label: Your copy of Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005) for Xbox 360, the USA release (EA-2009): its disc image (.iso), or a folder with its files and default.xex. No title update is needed.

prepare.label: Copying your disc's files and checking each one (7.1 GB)

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Full screen, or a window you can resize.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: Waits for the screen's refresh: no tearing. Off shows each frame as soon as it's ready.

settings.label: Frame Rate
settings.help: 60 is the game's own. Auto drops to 30 while the PC is too hot or too slow to hold 60.

settings.label: Internal Resolution
settings.help: What the 3D scene draws at. 1x is the console's 720p. Auto picks it from your screen (2x on a 1440p one).

settings.label: Anti-Aliasing
settings.help: Smooths jagged edges. Above 1x Internal Resolution the edges are smooth already, and off keeps the picture a little sharper.

settings.label: Haze
settings.help: The game's grey veil over dark areas. 100% is its own look; lower is clearer and deeper.

settings.label: Unlock Everything
settings.help: Every car, part, track and event from the start, in Quick Race and the career. Not saved in your profile: Off puts it back.

settings.label: Game Speed
settings.help: How fast the world runs in races. Below 100% is slow motion, a little less smooth.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: Your career and Quick Race profiles.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: The last runs' logs, and crash reports.

actions.label: Shader cache
actions.help: Shaders the game has built, so they don't stutter again. Clearing only helps if graphics look wrong after an update.
